notes.title: Patch Notes for March 7th
notes.content:
Fixes for the new version:
[list]
[*] Fixes for monitors beyond 60Hz, there should be no more input lag and the game should run at 60FPS instead of 65FPS
[*] Edge case with full screen<>windows transition has been fixed
[*] Added Zoom option to allow increase the game size when running on Pixel Perfect mode
[/list]

Hopefully there will be no more issues present on the game!
